opening.argument: The speaker shows how the referral pathway works: an Uber-provided URL becomes the target of a branded link, while a separate landing page collects email opt-ins. He openly says referral-code signups generate income for him and explains that his email list lets him offer an Uber course, coaching, and consulting. The video also shows promotional ride and earnings claims, but those claims do not establish a deceptive payment or credential request. What is observable is an instructional demonstration of signups, links, and disclosed monetization, not a supported deceptive pretext.
